evidence_class: CONTAINER EVIDENCE, NOT PRODUCTION. User decision of 2026-11-16: run the read-only footprint and reclamation-readiness checks against a throwaway Docker deployment instead of the live native database.
owner: Task 436011f3 developer through review, then repository maintainers
retention: Bounded release evidence until a dated production readiness receipt or feature retirement supersedes it. No raw logs, transcripts, query output or fixture copies are retained.

inputs.worktree: Clean for all measured sources; unrelated uncommitted docs/reference/request-performance.md and tools/request-latency.qualification.json belonged to another task.
inputs.head_at_handoff: e1465d6b4262eb746dad29fc84618ce3e65493c0; its two new commits change only Dockerfile, docs/reference/request-performance.md, tools/perftest/compose.yaml, tools/perftest/perftest.mjs and tools/request-latency.qualification.json, none of them a measured input.

container.compose_project: hmem-perftest (coordinator-owned throwaway, reused and left running)
container.runtime_login: hmem: bootstrap superuser, also the server and hmem-ctl login
container.seed: 574 synthetic claude-code-jsonl sessions sized to the 2026-11-02 production receipt; synthetic replicated audit rows; concurrent read-only use by another reviewer and steady active-session growth during capture

environment.fixtures: Windows 11 Pro 10.0.26200, Docker 29.6.1, GHC 9.10.2, Stack 3.11.1, ephemeral PostgreSQL 18.2, zlib-1.3.1, default-optimisation test builds (no -O0 override)

method.read_only: One REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY transaction with 120 s statement and 1 s lock timeouts, ending in ROLLBACK; status via the single-SELECT hmem-ctl path; authorized GETs for stored gzip content and original evidence ranges. No payload scans: octet_length and pg_column_size read TOAST pointers only.
throwaway_mutations: CREATE EXTENSION pgstattuple for one pgstattuple_approx capture, then DROP EXTENSION (throwaway database only; verified absent afterwards)
method.not_used: GET .../archive manifest: Reader.ensureArchive inserts a session_archive_requests row and may enqueue a job, so it is not a read-only check. session_archive_requests stayed at 0 rows.
method.estimates: Reusable and post-compaction sizes are allocation-proportional: session_chunks total allocation times the sealed share of stored raw values. They are not measured physical reclaimability.

read_only_steps: As the runtime login: hmem-ctl archives status --json

As the runtime login: psql -X -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -d hmem -f tools/perftest/archive-readiness.sql (stdout is one JSON document; the login needs the core privileges listed in the script header; optional items it cannot read are null and listed in not_readable)

Optional: select percentile rows from session_archives, then node tools/perftest/archive-readback.mjs --base https://HOST --targets FILE with a read-capable HMEM_API_KEY or --secrets FILE (an explicit --secrets takes precedence; redirects are refused; the throwaway secrets default applies only to loopback; plain http to other hosts needs --allow-http; per-request --timeout-ms, default 120000)
On the host: PGDATA and pg_wal sizes, free disk on the volume, and current backup sizes
avoid: GET .../archive manifest routes (they record an archive request)
Any hmem-ctl archives command other than status
production_procedure.record: A dated production receipt with the same figures, labelled production

container_cannot_satisfy: Deployment-specific current figures: the container holds synthetic seeded data, not the live native database.
Production login grants and runtime_safe: the container uses one bootstrap superuser.
Production backup, restore and disk free space: none exist for the container.
Production transcript format mix and sanitized eligibility: the seed has only claude-code-jsonl, and the documented policy example targets codex_jsonl.
Production PostgreSQL 18 behaviour: the container runs 17.11 with zlib-1.2.13, and audit maintenance runtime safety requires 18.
Production WAL, backfill and qualification settings: production had backfill and qualification enabled on 2026-11-02.
limitations: Single capture of a live throwaway database; active sessions grew during capture.
Estimates are allocation-proportional, not measured physical reclaimability.
Host load from the container and another reviewer was uncontrolled during fixture timings.
Fixtures use synthetic valid JSONL and a 250 s guard; no browser run.
